dispatch_origin: Each actual coordinate call owns a local Boolean. The supported NEW callback marks only the exact authorized Node runner invocation, after argv/kwargs/attestation validation and immediately before binary dispatch. Metadata CLI calls never mark it.
exception_rule: If coordinate raises after that dispatch mark and returns no fully validated result, OR-latch descendant uncertainty before first-origin persistence, safety observers or finalization. Malformed/missing/wrong-attestation/outer-exit-mismatch responses do not prove inner exit. Never parse them to manufacture closure.
facade_order: For the exact validated Node dispatch only, the NEW command facade also marks uncertainty before translating or persisting a TransportStop. This prevents text-decoding/binary failure recording from preceding the outer coordinate exception latch. Metadata and authentication CLI calls retain their existing physical-closure handling.
contrasts: Pre-Node failure leaves inner CLI unattempted; independently closed processes and global-zero may permit original-grantor finalization. A fully validated integer-exit nonzero result remains a confirmed-closed failure. Exact validated null/unknown result still latches uncertainty immediately on return.
first_origin: Original allowlisted source13 code and GENUINE operation phase remain primary under later observers or IO; all later failures are secondary. Fixed safe fields only.
